# CopilotForge - Copilot Studio

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Design and deliver low-code and enterprise agents with appropriate actions, data, ALM and lifecycle controls.

- **Layer:** delivery
- **Lead role:** Copilot Studio Architect
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-copilot-studio`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`conversation-design`](skills/conversation-design/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Improve | Designs how a Copilot Studio agent talks to people - greeting and AI disclosure, tone, clarifying questions, confirmations, error and fallback messages, escalation and live-agent hand-off with context, and ending a conversation well - so exchanges are short, honest and recoverable. Use when writing an agent's conversational behaviour, when users abandon or go round in loops, or when a hand-off to people needs designing. |
| [`dataverse-integration`](skills/dataverse-integration/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure | Designs how a Copilot Studio agent works with Dataverse - tables as knowledge for questions about business records, reads and writes through tools, and the agent's own configuration and conversation data - covering table and column selection, security roles, capacity questions and environment placement. Use when an agent must answer from or update Dataverse records, or when agent data storage needs planning. |
| [`multi-agent-design`](skills/multi-agent-design/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Deliver, Scale | Designs Copilot Studio solutions in which agents work together - child agents, connected agents reused across teams and calls to agents on other Microsoft platforms - deciding when to split, how the parent routes and passes context, which identity each uses, who owns each and how failures are contained. Use when one agent has grown too broad, when teams want to reuse each other's agents, or when an agent must hand work to another. |
| [`power-automate-actions`](skills/power-automate-actions/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure | Designs Power Automate flows that a Copilot Studio agent calls as tools - when a flow is the right action, its input and output contract, response time within a conversation, the identity it runs under, error returns the agent can explain, solution packaging and flow ownership. Use when an agent needs a multi-step or cross-system action, when a flow called by an agent times out or fails silently, or when a maker wants to reuse an existing flow. |
| [`studio-actions-and-tools`](skills/studio-actions-and-tools/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure | Designs the tools a Copilot Studio agent can call - connector actions, agent flows, prompts, custom connectors, REST APIs and MCP servers - with names and descriptions the orchestrator can use, typed inputs and outputs, read versus write, user confirmation, identity and failure behaviour. Use when an agent must do more than answer, when it calls the wrong tool or fills inputs badly, or when a write action needs safeguards. |
| [`studio-agent-design`](skills/studio-agent-design/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Deliver | Turns an agreed agent brief into a Copilot Studio solution design - orchestration approach, topics, knowledge, tools and flows, authentication, channels, environment and solution packaging, and the run model - recording each design decision with the alternatives rejected. Use when a brief has chosen Copilot Studio, when a maker is about to build without a design, or when a growing agent needs its architecture reset. |
| [`studio-agent-lifecycle`](skills/studio-agent-lifecycle/SKILL.md) | draft | Launch, Measure, Scale, Improve | Keeps the technical estate of Copilot Studio agents healthy from creation to retirement - owners and co-owners, orphaned, inactive or duplicate agents, periodic recertification, Microsoft platform changes, and retiring an agent with its flows, connections, environment variables and stored data. Use when the number of Studio agents is growing, when a maker leaves, or when an agent has gone unused for months. |
| [`studio-alm`](skills/studio-alm/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Deliver, Launch, Improve | Sets application lifecycle management for Copilot Studio agents - solutions and publishers, environment variables and connection references, source control, pipelines between development, test and production, managed versus unmanaged imports, versioning, change control and rollback. Use when an agent must move beyond one environment, when changes are made directly in production, or when several makers work on the same agent. |
| [`studio-analytics`](skills/studio-analytics/SKILL.md) | draft | Measure, Improve | Uses Copilot Studio analytics and conversation records to improve a live agent - sessions, outcomes such as resolved, escalated and abandoned, unanswered questions, knowledge and tool use, satisfaction and recurring themes - through a regular improvement review at aggregate level that turns findings into prioritised fixes. Use when an agent is live and its owner asks how it is doing, when resolution falls, or when deciding what to fix next. |

Use when a maker needs a connector the agent does not yet use, when a custom connector is proposed, or when a data policy blocks an agent. |

Use when an agent has passed its release gate, when it is being added to a new channel, or when users cannot find or open it. |
| [`studio-environments`](skills/studio-environments/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Deliver, Scale | Applies the organisation's environment strategy to Copilot Studio work - the concrete personal, team, test and production environments makers use, environment routing for new makers, Managed Environment and agent settings per zone, security groups, data policies and how agents move between zones. Use when a Studio agent with tools, topics or several sources needs testing, or when a change must be regression-tested. |
